minimumOwnerInput.needed: An actual user account in this isolated project, established through the user's authentication or separately authorized provisioning; then the verified issuer/sub and explicit operator/reviewer mapping. A dashboard administrator identity, production user, or supplied email alone is not a verified project Auth subject.
The exact redirect URI shown for the specific ChatGPT custom MCP connection. Never infer a callback ID or register a wildcard.

supabaseActivationRequest.registrationDefault: Pre-register one client with the exact observed ChatGPT callback. Enable DCR only if selected host workflow needs it; new clients still receive no V2 membership automatically.
supabaseActivationRequest.uriAllowListNote: Supabase site redirect uri_allow_list is separate from OAuth client redirect_uris. This password-only consent UI needs no magic-link redirect entry. Do not add broad ChatGPT domains or wildcards.

rules: Existing-account login goes directly to the isolated issuer.
No signup, OTP, email, invitation, password logging, browser persistence or auto-consent.
Verify issuer, ES256/RS256 signature, authenticated login audience, expiry and explicit subject membership before consent.
Show actual client/scopes and require explicit approve or deny.
Validate returned redirect against the exact configured callback list.

officialSourceInspection.authorize: internal/api/oauthserver/authorize.go parses/stores resource and validates URI shape.
officialSourceInspection.tokenExchange: internal/api/oauthserver/handlers.go rejects supplied token resource differing from authorization resource.
officialSourceInspection.accessToken: internal/tokens/service.go sets Audience to user.Aud; resource is not assigned to the access-token audience.
officialSourceInspection.confidence: Source-supported inference, not a verified hosted OAuth token. Real hosted flow remains required.

candidateHookPlan.permissions: Admin-owned private schema and SECURITY INVOKER function. Only supabase_auth_admin gets schema USAGE, policy/client/subject SELECT and function EXECUTE; app/API roles denied.
candidateHookPlan.clientMapping: Explicit approved client_id -> exact V2 MCP resource, inserted only after real client registration; never accept client-controlled audience or arbitrary mapping.
behavior: If claims.client_id is absent, return unchanged login claims (aud authenticated).
If client_id is present but not approved, return a supported authorization failure.
Require an explicitly approved subject and required granted scopes; unknown users are denied.
For the explicitly approved OAuth client, replace only aud with the exact V2 MCP resource; preserve client_id and granted scope.
Refresh issuance must follow the same client mapping. Do not rely only on authentication_method.
candidateHookPlan.resourceLimitation: The documented/current hook input and authorization-details response do not expose raw resource. This hook pins a registered client to one resource; it does not independently validate the raw requested resource. Do not invent event fields or claim echo validation. Upstream authorization/token resource matching plus exact audience verification must be tested. If strict request-resource allowlisting is required, use a supported provider feature or reviewed authorization-server design before activation.

chatgptRegistration.surface: Current ChatGPT Plugins > plus > Add custom MCP server; availability depends on account/workspace permissions.
chatgptRegistration.stableCallbackRequires: Matching issuer in protected-resource and AS metadata, authorization_response_iss_parameter_supported=true, and exact iss in every successful/error authorization response.
registrationOptions: Explicit client registration with observed callback and host-compatible token endpoint authentication method.
DCR if needed: enable only in this project, let ChatGPT register; capture actual client_id and bind it before granting V2 access.
chatgptRegistration.offlineAccess: Current issuer advertises offline_access. Request it and verify refresh issuance and renewal before claiming persistent ChatGPT connectivity.
chatgptRegistration.publishing: Private testing only; no workspace publication or sharing is implied.

runnableImplementation.scope: Only new project muyyitsvkkjzjojetynr and exact isolated Render origin. Does not run at startup.
runnableImplementation.inputRules: Supply actual registered OAuth client UUIDs, exact callbacks and existing confirmed password-account subject UUIDs; no synthetic or production identities. Input and admin environment files require mode0600.
runnableImplementation.commandEffects: Default uses BEGIN READ ONLY. --apply installs SQL only after existing user/client metadata checks; never changes Auth config, creates users, registers clients or sends email. Output contains intended authPatch and runtimeEnvironment for separate review.
runnableImplementation.existingPolicy: Same input is replayable; a different policy fails instead of silently overwriting.
runnableImplementation.activation: After real identity/callback and SQL receipt, separately review/apply the returned project Auth patch and runtime variables; perform actual login/code/refresh verification. No actual Auth activation has occurred.

coverage: Real local PostgreSQL hook audience/login/refresh and permission enforcement
